title: The Frequency Contacts card and composer draw in the kit (Contacts phase 2)
detail: Contacts phase 2, parked 2026-10-14, active 2026-10-19. Plan in SCAN-872's detail. contacts-body.tsx:9,128 still mounts DAWN's SpaceMemberViewer. CLOSED 2026-10-20 (owner said go on the side-by-side): the Workspace view is now components/frequency/admin/pages/contacts/contacts-workspace.tsx, the kit's tier chips, round search pill and rows beside the selected person's card, with the same roster, lazy detail action and composer. contacts-body.tsx no longer mounts SpaceMemberViewer, so the contacts folder imports nothing from components/spaces/crm/*. The card and composer are the shared CrmMemberDetailPane, which already takes the kit tokens (pastel pill, ink). Nothing was dropped from the old viewer: Tier is chips, and Role, Business, Activity, Lifecycle and the sort choice open from a Filters pill (the same facets and sort options the DAWN roster used). Search covers name, handle and headline.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const d='components/frequency/admin/pages/contacts/';const needle='from \x27@/components/spaces/crm/';const bad=fs.readdirSync(d).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.tsx')&&fs.readFileSync(d+f,'utf8').includes(needle));if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-936: DAWN CRM import in '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync(d+'contacts-workspace.tsx')){console.error('LIVE-936: contacts-workspace.tsx missing');process.exit(1)}"
